def record(
        jobId: Option[String],
        kind: ApprovalKind,
        citekey: String,
        status: Option[Source.Status],
        current: Option[Source.Status],
        edgeKind: Option[Edge.Kind],
        target: Option[String],
        payload: String,
        state: ApprovalState,
        result: Option[String]
    ): Option[ApprovalInfo] =
      val (st, ek) = (status.map(_.wire), edgeKind.map(Edge.Kind.wireOf))
      def same(r: ApprovalRecord) =
        state == ApprovalState.Open && r.state == Open && r.kind == kind.wire && r.citekey.contains(citekey) &&
          r.status.getOrElse("") == st.getOrElse("") && r.edgeKind.getOrElse("") == ek.getOrElse("") &&
          r.target.getOrElse("") == target.getOrElse("")
      val at = now
      AutomationState.insertApproval(this.state)(same)(id =>
        ApprovalRecord(
          id,
          jobId,
          None,
          kind.wire,
          Some(citekey),
          st,
          current.map(_.wire),
          ek,
          target,
          None,
          payload,
          state.wire,
          None,
          result,
          at,
          decidedAt(state)
        )
      ).flatMap(approval)

def proposedBefore(
        kind: ApprovalKind,
        citekey: String,
        status: Option[Source.Status],
        edgeKind: Option[Edge.Kind],
        target: Option[String]
    ): Boolean =
      rows.exists(r =>
        r.kind == kind.wire && r.citekey.contains(citekey) && r.status.getOrElse("") == status.fold("")(_.wire) &&
          r.edgeKind.getOrElse("") == edgeKind.fold("")(Edge.Kind.wireOf) && r.target.getOrElse("") == target
            .getOrElse("")
      )

def record(
      jobId: Option[String],
      kind: ApprovalKind,
      citekey: String,
      status: Option[Source.Status],
      current: Option[Source.Status],
      edgeKind: Option[Edge.Kind],
      target: Option[String],
      payload: String,
      state: ApprovalState,
      result: Option[String],
      now: java.time.Instant
  )(using DbCon): Option[ApprovalInfo] =
    val decided = Option.when(state != ApprovalState.Open)(now.toString)
    sql"""INSERT INTO approvals (job_id, kind, citekey, status, current_status, edge_kind, target, proposal, state,
                                 result, decided_at)
          VALUES ($jobId, ${kind.wire}, $citekey, ${status.map(_.wire)}, ${current.map(_.wire)},
                  ${edgeKind.map(Edge.Kind.wireOf)}, $target, $payload::jsonb, ${state.wire}, $result,
                  $decided::timestamptz)
          ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id"""
      .query[Long]
      .run()
      .headOption
      .flatMap(approval(_))
